note: WCALPHA attacker and defender formulas remain in player-quality-wcalpha-v1.json as the untouched parity baseline. This version adds midfielder and goalkeeper formulas, splits centre-backs from fullbacks, flattens all metric weights, and rebuilds the league-quality and reliability policies.

peer_method.peer_minimum_minutes_note: Mean and SD are computed from the qualifying subset only; the resulting z-score is applied to every player, including short samples.

standardisation.note: standardised_z = (composite - position_mean) / position_sd. Applied so a +1.0 forward and a +1.0 goalkeeper are the same statement about quality. Without it, forward grades span roughly twice the range of centre-back grades and the roll-up weights amplify the artifact.

shrinkage.order_note: Standardising first makes zero mean 'average for this position', so shrinkage pulls thin samples toward their positional average rather than toward an arbitrary point.

minimum_attempts.note: Percentage metrics below their attempt threshold are treated as missing and their weight leaves the denominator. Thresholds are set so measurement error sits below the population spread; they are starting values and should be retuned once real distributions exist.

league_quality.replaces_note: v3 multiplied the raw metric value by a multiplier taken from the player's CURRENT club league. That ran backwards on inverted metrics (a weak-league defender scored better for identical errors) and moved percentage metrics roughly 2.5x harder than rate metrics. It also credited a transferred player's previous-league statistics to the league of the club they now play for.
league_quality.cup_tie_rule: A cup fixture takes the offset of the opponent's domestic league, which requires one cached team lookup per unknown opponent.
league_quality.champions_league_note: FotMob match rows carry stage ids (904988, 904995), not the league id 42 used to fetch the competition. Mapping only 42 sent every Champions League minute to the -0.9 default, which graded the strongest club competition as the weakest. The opponent's domestic league still wins where the opponent is identifiable; this tier is only the fallback for opponents outside the current club universe, and it sits high because every Champions League opponent is one of its country's best sides.

weighting_policy.note: Every metric inside a formula carries equal weight, so the composite is an unweighted mean of available z-scores and the listed order is display only. The WCALPHA 3.0-to-1.0 ladder was never fitted; flat is the honest prior and it removes the accidental concentration the ladder produced (centre-backs went from 57% of their grade on duels and mistakes to 40%).

press90.label: Possessions won in attacking third per 90

pace.label: Pace
pace.unavailable_reason: physical_metrics_topspeed reaches only 90 of 263 centre-backs (34%). Coverage is concentrated in the Premier League and Champions League while the domestic leagues largely omit it, so populating it would give centre-backs with continental minutes an eleventh metric their domestic-only peers cannot have, inside the same peer population. A clean shared gap is safer than an uneven one.

excluded_metrics.avail: Minutes played was a scored metric in the WCALPHA midfielder and goalkeeper formulas. Removed: availability belongs to Club Form, and scoring it here would count minutes twice and only for two of the five positions.
excluded_metrics.savepct: Save percentage measures the same event set and outcome as goals prevented, without adjusting for shot quality. Excluded rather than used as a fallback; when direct goals prevented is unavailable, gprev90 derives from expected goals on target faced minus goals conceded.
excluded_metrics.defensive_actions: An aggregate of tackles, clearances, interceptions, recoveries and blocks. Using it alongside its components would double count.
excluded_metrics.xg_and_xa: An aggregate of expected_goals and expected_assists. Same reason.
excluded_metrics.gd: Overall duel win percentage contains aerial duels, so pairing it with aer was whole-plus-part. Replaced by gnd, which partitions cleanly against aer.
excluded_metrics.tb90: No through-balls key exists in FotMob match detail. line_breaking_passes is a broader measure and was adopted as its own slot rather than mapped as a substitute.
excluded_metrics.vers: Versatility has no provider field. Calculable from usualPosition and positionId across match lineups; not yet built.
excluded_metrics.pace: physical_metrics_topspeed exists but reaches only 34% of centre-backs, concentrated in the Premier League and Champions League. Asymmetric coverage inside one peer population is worse than a shared gap, so pace stays missing and its weight leaves the denominator, matching the WCALPHA baseline.

roll_up.note: Position weights only. Starter/rotation/squad role and expected minutes belong to Club Form and multiply in at the roll-up, never inside Player Ratings.
roll_up.fitting_plan: Regress goals scored and conceded in the 569 completed 2025/26 PL and UCL fixtures on the two ratings to replace these priors with measured values.

coverage.redefinition_deferred: Coverage currently reports structural formula gaps rather than per-player data quality, so every graded player reads the same value. Once standardisation and shrinkage land it no longer feeds the grade, so redefining it changes no ratings.
